content.title: Who is John Ternus Apple’s Next CEO ? Check Biography, Career, Education,and Net Worth
content.text: Apple Inc. has officially announced a leadership transition. John Ternus will take over as Apple CEO from Tim Cook on September 1, 2026, with Tim Cook transitioning to Cheif Executive Chairman(CEO). Ternus, a long-time hardware chief, is recognized for his pivotal role in Apple's product innovation and engineering achievements.This transition marks only the second time in the 21st century that Apple has changed its top leadership. Apple Inc. confirmed that Tim Cook will step down from the CEO position he has held since 2011. The Board of Directors has unanimously appointed John Ternus as the new CEO.Who is John Ternus?John Ternus is a veteran Apple executive who has spent over 25 years at the company before being named successor to Tim Cook, Ternus served as Senior Vice President of Hardware Engineering where he is known for his calm demeanor and deep technical expertise. Ternus has been a "visionary" force behind some of Apple's most successful product launches in recent years. Full Name: John Patrick Ternus Born: May 1975 Age (2026): 51 Years Education: University of Pennsylvania Current Role: CEO of Apple Inc. (from Sept 1, 2026) Previous Role: SVP, Hardware Engineering Net Worth: $75–100 Million (approx.) John Ternus Biography: Age, Education, and Early LifeUnderstanding the man behind the machine requires looking back at his journey from a mechanical engineer to a global tech leader.Early Life John Patrick Ternus was born in May 1975 in California, USA. Growing up in the heart of the tech revolution, Ternus was reportedly a "hands-on" child often fascinated by the mechanics of everyday objects. Age in 2026: 51 Years Birthplace: California, United States Educational John Ternus holds a Bachelor of Science in Mechanical Engineering from the University of Pennsylvania (Class of 1997) during his time at Pennsylvania, he was also a competitive athlete where he serv as a member of the university's varsity swim team.Related Stories University of Pennsylvania:Bachelor of Science in Mechanical Engineering (BSME) from University of Pennsylvania in 1997. Athletic Discipline: A varsity swimmer for the Pennsylvania Men’s Swimming team earned the title of an "all-time letterwinner" in 1994. Career Before joining the ranks of Cupertino, Ternus cut his teeth in the world of high-end research and development.Pre-Apple Career (1997–2001): From 1997 to 2001, he served as a mechanical engineer at Virtual Research Systems where he focused on Virtual Reality (VR) headsets later at Apple with the development of the Apple Vision Pro John Ternus Career at Apple John Ternus joined Apple’s Product Design team in 2001 focused on Apple’s spatial computing efforts. Ternus has good problem-solving skills which made him Vice President of Hardware Engineering in 2013 by overseeing the Mac and iPad divisions. In April 2021, he took over the top hardware job from Dan Riccio and managed the engineering teams for the iPhone, iPad, Mac, AirPods, and more. John Ternus Contributions at AppleJohn Ternus is often credited as the "architect" of the modern Apple hardware era which includes: Apple Silicon Transition: He played a pivotal role in shift from Intel core processors to M-series chips that redefined Mac performance. Mac Development: redesigning of the MacBook Pro and iMac by bringing back fan-favorite features and improving efficiency. Product Innovation: one of the central to development of iPhone 17 series and iPhone Air, as well as expansion of iPad Pro line. Why John Ternus Was Chosen as Apple’s CEOThe decision to make John Ternus as next CEO of Apple Inc. over other high-ranking executives boils down. He is described as a "stabilizing force" with a collaborative approach that resonates with Apple’s internal culture. Having worked under both Steve Jobs and Tim Cook, he carries the "Apple DNA." It has been seen that Tim Cook has publicly praised Ternus calling him a "brilliant engineer and thinker" who is without question the right person to lead.Tim Cook as Executive Chairman of AppleTim Cook will be the Executive Chairman of Apple Inc. He will focus on global policy engagement and sustainability initiatives, mentor John Ternus during this transition phase and will continue to represent Apple’s brand values on the world stage.John Ternus Net Worth in 2026In 2026, John Ternus’s estimated net worth is approximately $75 million to $100 million although his base salary as SVP was high, a significant portion of his wealth comes from Restricted Stock Units (RSUs) and performance bonuses. Following his appointment as new CEO of Apple his compensation package will include stock options that are expected to increase significantly which would place him among the highest-paid executives in the tech world.Apple Inc. has announced that John Ternus will succeed Tim Cook as CEO, effective September 1, 2026, while Cook will transition to Executive Chairman. Ternus, a veteran Apple executive, is known for his role in hardware engineering and product innovation.First Published: Apr 21, 2026, 04:26 IST
